purpose: Classify stale, generated, FlowDocs-consumer, and Flow-core audit scripts so gates stop mixing source-of-truth layers.
sourceOfTruthRules: Flow core gates may read package source, generated runtime from package builds, token outputs, specs, and package tests.
FlowDocs gates may prove docs consume Flow, but must not define component API, accessibility, state, motion, or token truth.
docs/audits/*.json reports are evidence snapshots, not source contracts.
Legacy ZIP/gold/parity narratives are forensic references unless rewritten into source-backed contracts.

blockingFindings.issue: Legacy all-in-one gate still mixes Flow core, FlowDocs app files, content ownership, generated reports, and visual/doc parity checks.
blockingFindings.action: Do not use as the trustworthy system gate until split into core, consumer, content, and forensic gates.

blockingFindings.issue: Runs generated evidence checks such as component 1:1 matrix and FlowDocs template composition alongside package contracts.
blockingFindings.action: Keep package/runtime checks; move template composition and generated quality matrix checks out of the integration gate.

blockingFindings.issue: Includes FlowDocs demo ownership and generated reporting in the same scope as React/package boundary checks.
blockingFindings.action: Split FlowDocs consumer ownership from Flow core readiness.
